structured_output.summary: The track radiogroup's keydown handler in src/ui/start-screen.ts now starts with `if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;`, the same guard src/input/keyboard.ts uses. Arrow keys pressed with Alt, Ctrl or Meta are browser shortcuts (Alt+Left for Back, Cmd+Up/Down to scroll), so they no longer change the track and preventDefault is no longer called on them. Plain arrow keys still move the selection. I added tests/ui/track-select-modifier-keys.test.ts: the verifier's test plus a check that a plain ArrowRight still selects the next card and is prevented. It failed before the fix and passes after it. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (110 files, 734 tests).
